_comment: 3rd mockup variant (hybrid-desktop-phones) verification. 1 desktop browser frame (back) + 2 phones (front, flanking). For apps that are BOTH desktop AND mobile (Applivation = Mac+Safari ext AND iOS). All 3 devices share mockup-inner-N and animate yPercent in lockstep. Text-only Playwright, 1600x1000 + 375x812.
axisLogic: unchanged in App.jsx: axis = type==='desktop-browser' ? 'xPercent' : 'yPercent'. hybrid is not desktop-browser -> yPercent. No App.jsx edit needed.

lockstepProof.note: Single GSAP yPercent:-50 tween on .mockup-inner-1 drives all 3 devices; each reveals its 2nd screen. Per-slide feel (1.5-unit yPercent inner anim) identical to dual-phone variants.

desktop_layout_1600x1000.phoneDesktopOverlap: phones overlap desktop's left (852-974) and right (1111-1232) edges in front (z-20/z-10 vs desktop z-0); desktop peeks out between phones (974-1111) and at top/bottom
desktop_layout_1600x1000.stagger: phone2 raised 32px (md:-translate-y-8) for depth; both within 600px stage

gracefulCells: each cell renders an if {src,alt} present, else a branded placeholder ({label,emoji,barClass}). Ships now with all-placeholder cells; adding src to any cell swaps it to the real screenshot (data-only change in panels-data.js).
screenshotCountWhenLive: desktop.cells (2) + phones[0].cells (2) + phones[1].cells (2) = 6 screenshots for full animation. Fewer is fine — missing srcs render as placeholders.
result: PASS -- 3rd variant lands cleanly. 1 desktop + 2 phones, all 3 animate yPercent in lockstep, no App.jsx change. Desktop+mobile layout correct at both breakpoints. Ready for Eric's screenshots (data-only swap).
